latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker AI TikTok.

- Create TikTok-ready videos from uploaded clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) using AI—just describe your edit and export 1080p MP4s.
- Automated backend handles upload, session management, AI editing, and cloud rendering pipeline (30–90 seconds typical render time).
- Supports captions, background music, aspect ratio adjustments, text overlays, and more via natural language prompts.
- Includes session-based workflow with credits/balance tracking, export download management, and error handling.
- Simple one-step onboarding: uses NEMO_TOKEN if available, or fetches a temporary anonymous token for 7 days.
- File type, error messaging, and credits usage transparently managed; supports multiple video/image/audio formats.
